reasons.high_margin: Clear top match with distinct confidence margin.
reasons.low_margin: Top candidates are too close in score; human verification needed.
reasons.attribute_mismatch: Extracted query attributes do not match candidate specifications.
reasons.dependency_unavailable: Search dependency is currently unavailable; falling back to catalog keyword search.
reasons.empty_query: Query was empty or whitespace only.
reasons.not_found: No matching parts found in catalog.
